title: Apply takes off the template pages of kinds the customer did not pick, never home or contact, with a products/services stand-in and system menus safe
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-picked-pages.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wordpress.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "a page is a kind only when every word of its address names that one kind"; "the pages of kinds the customer did not pick go; home, contact and the pages no kind names stay"; "products picked and none on the template: its services page stands in for them, and nothing is said"; "a note says a picked kind is missing only when every page could be read; a page no kind names is never taken off"; "no `pages` answer, an old brief, or an answer with no known page changes nothing"; "Joomla: the menu entries of unpicked pages go with their own entries under them, in every language a visitor reaches"; "Joomla: an entry of a menu no visitor navigates by, the home entry, and one the site cannot read are never unpublished"; "Joomla: nothing to hide when the customer did not answer `pages`"; "the menu entries of pages the customer did not pick go in the tidy-up, with the entries that only lead to them"; "an entry taken off because its page was not picked is not also retitled in the same batch"; "a tidy-up of more than 100 records goes in transactions of at most 100, not one record at a time"; "a menu that cannot be read is said, and the pages not picked stay"; "the pages of kinds the customer did not pick go; home and contact stay"; "products picked on a template that has services and no products: Services stays and nothing is said"; "the slots of a page the customer did not pick are not planned, and that page is taken off"; "a brief with no `pages` answer hides no page for it".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 124).

Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): a page is a kind only when every word of its address names that one kind; pages of unpicked kinds go (WordPress: drafted with the sweep, its slots not planned; Joomla: its menu entries and the ones under them unpublished in transactions of at most 100), home and contact never, Services stands in for picked Products and the reverse, a missing picked kind is noted only when every page could be read, no `pages` answer changes nothing, and a system-menu entry, the home entry or an unreadable menu is never unpublished.
evidence: Ledger L04, 05/10/2026: a customer who picked only Home, Product, About and Contact still got Services, News and Projects published, and picking Pricing made no page: Apply turned the `pages` answer into a line of text. Reds 4a2262563, 2c81f358e, 3e2ecdbe6, 20affbbc3, 392cd54ac; fixes e6f510e5d, ef27d0272, fdf0a92e4, b81925f84, 70a25320c.
fence: Only pages whose address clearly names an unpicked kind are taken off (unpublished/drafted, never deleted); a picked kind the template lacks is noted, never created.
